description: This source file contains unit tests for the OpenClaw iOS/macOS application, specifically focused on onboarding remote authentication prompts, error handling, token visibility rules, and user guidance messages.

classes.name: OnboardingRemoteAuthPromptTests
classes.description: A test suite for onboarding remote authentication prompts and related user interface and error handling logic.

methods.name: `auth detail codes map to remote auth issues`
methods.description: Tests that various GatewayConnectAuthError detail codes map correctly to RemoteGatewayAuthIssue enumeration values.

methods.name: `password detail family maps to password required issue`
methods.description: Verifies that password-related errors map to a password required issue.

methods.name: `token field visibility follows onboarding rules`
methods.description: Checks whether the remote token input field should be visible based on onboarding rules and current state.

methods.name: `pairing required copy points users to pair approve`
methods.description: Ensures that the user interface copy for pairing required issues points users to the correct command.

methods.name: `paired device success copy explains auth source`
methods.description: Verifies that success messages correctly describe the authentication source post-pairing.

methods.name: `transient probe mode restore does not clear probe feedback`
methods.description: Tests that probe feedback is preserved in specific transient modes unless explicitly reset.
